title: Transportation Complaint
description: Use this service request for concerns regarding transportation services such as ambulances, limousines and taxi's, as well as, non-motorized transportation, i.e., carriages, petty cabs, trolley's, etc. Also use to request regulation of drivers, permits and companies. Contact information is required to submit this service request. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What type of transportation is this regarding?

branches.Ambulance: Company, concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number, unit number
branches.Petty cab: Concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number
branches.Other: Ask If other, please describe:, then concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number
branches.Taxi: Company, concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number, unit number
branches.Carriage: Concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number
branches.Non-motorized: Concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number
branches.Limousine: Company, concern, driver, pickup date/time and location, vehicle number, unit number

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a regulated transportation service or driver.
actions.why: For concerns about an ambulance, limousine, taxi, carriage, pedicab, or other nonmotorized transportation service, driver, company, or permit. The 311 request form includes unsafe driving, harassment, rude conduct, missing identification or permit, and taxi meter or fare issues; it asks for company, driver, vehicle, pickup location, and date or time when known. The description says contact information is required.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Transportation and Regulation" > Choose "Transportation Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Transportation and Regulation" > Choose "Transportation Complaint"
